D-NETWORK is looking for a permanent IT Desktop/Web Platforms Manager, Engineering Manager for a customer based in Mechelen.

You're Fluent in English with

• Minimum 10 years of professional experience in software engineering, including significant time (at least 3 years) in engineering leadership or people-management roles.
• Proven experience leading teams delivering complex, long-lived production software where reliability, quality, and risk management are critical.
• An expertise in the medical device or healthcare industry sector is a big plus.
• Contract in CDI/ Permanent role/ Employee (no freelancer for this opportunity).
 

Position Overview :

The Engineering Manager (Desktop/Web Platforms) plays a pivotal leadership role in this transformation.

This role is a technical people-leadership and engineering accountability role.

It is not a Product Owner, Project Manager, Scrum Master, or Tech Lead role.

The Engineering Manager partners closely with Architecture, Tech Leads, DevOps, V&V, QA, Regulatory Affairs, Product, and Delivery Management to ensure teams deliver medical-grade software safely, predictably, and at scale.

 

The primary purpose of this role is to:

• Build and sustain high-performing engineering teams

• Ensure predictable, high-quality execution

• Strengthen engineering maturity and standards adoption

• Reduce delivery risk and technical ambiguity

• Ensure compliance Quality Management System (QMS) and regulatory obligations

Profile / Requirements

• Master degree in Engineering /Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical & Computer Engineering.

• Demonstrated, senior-level experience leading engineering teams responsible for complex, long-lived, production software where failure has material business, safety, or regulatory consequences.

• Proven record of people leadership over execution: you build, scale, and correct teams through expectations, systems, and accountability—not by being the smartest engineer in the room.

• Unambiguous experience hiring, developing, and performance-managing engineers, including senior engineers and Tech Leads; comfortable making hard calls to protect team and product integrity.

• Sufficient technical depth to challenge architectural, quality, and delivery decisions credibly, without acting as the architect, Tech Lead, or primary implementer.

• Direct exposure to regulated, safety-critical, or audit-driven software environments; understands traceability, reproducibility, documentation, and compliance as first-class engineering concerns, not overhead.

• Demonstrated ability to deliver predictably in environments with conflicting priorities, incomplete information,

and regulatory constraints, using disciplined planning and risk management rather than optimism.

• Proven capability to operate in global, distributed organisations, aligning teams across sites, time zones, and cultures while maintaining consistent engineering standards.

• Strong executive judgment: able to make, explain, and defend difficult trade-offs that prioritise long-term engineering health, patient safety, and organisational credibility over short-term wins.

• Ability to represent engineering reality clearly and without dilution to Directors, VPs, and cross-functional leaders, including transparent communication of risks, constraints, and consequences.

• Demonstrated intolerance for weak engineering discipline, hero-driven execution, and ambiguity in ownership or decision-making

• High personal standards for integrity, accountability, and professionalism in a medical or safety-critical context.

• Excellent command of technical English; precise, concise, and credible in written and verbal communication.

• Willingness to travel as required to maintain alignment, trust, and execution across global teams.

• Advanced degree in Software Engineering or a closely related discipline, demonstrating depth in software design, systems thinking, and long-term technical decision-making.

• Demonstrated experience designing, evolving, or governing complex software architectures in regulated or safety-critical environments (medical devices strongly preferred), with clear understanding of design-for-quality, traceability, and auditability.

• Strong working knowledge of applicable medical-device or safety-critical regulations, with practical experience embedding compliance into everyday engineering practices rather than treating it as a downstream activity.

• Credible understanding of modern AI/ML concepts and their application boundaries, risks, and governance considerations in regulated software systems (not hands-on model building, but informed leadership and judgment).

 

• Demonstrated ability to anticipate future technology shifts and guide teams through adoption decisions responsibly, balancing innovation with safety, maintainability, and regulatory expectations.

• Build senior leadership judgment by owning engineering direction, quality posture, and delivery capability where compliance and reliability are mandatory.

• Operate at executive level, balancing technology, regulation, delivery risk, and long-term organisational health with Directors and VPs.

jobs.occupation: Microsoft Power Platform & Dataverse Administrator M/W/X
jobs.description:
At CGIC, we specialise in connecting experienced IT professionals with leading companies and international organisations.

We are currently looking for an experienced Microsoft Power Platform & Dataverse Administrator to join an IT infrastructure project within a European institution in Brussels.

This position focuses on the administration, governance, security, maintenance and continuous improvement of Microsoft Power Platform and Dataverse environments, ensuring the reliability, performance and security of enterprise business applications and automation solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical administration skills with experience in Microsoft 365 governance, platform operations and enterprise security.

Your Role:

As a Microsoft Power Platform & Dataverse Administrator, your main responsibilities will include:

• Power Platform Administration: Manage environments, security groups, tenant settings, capacity allocation and Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies.
• Dataverse Administration: Manage tables, permissions, security roles, business units, service accounts, backups, retention policies and storage capacity.
• Power Automate Operations: Monitor automated workflows, troubleshoot failures, manage connectors and ensure the reliability of business-critical automations.
• Copilot Studio Administration: Manage copilots and AI agents, including publishing, authentication, knowledge sources, security and lifecycle management.
• Platform Governance: Implement and maintain governance frameworks, security policies and access controls across Microsoft 365 and Power Platform environments.
• Monitoring & Security: Monitor platform performance, usage analytics, permissions and audit logs to ensure compliance with enterprise security standards.
• Integration & Maintenance: Support integrations between Power Platform, Microsoft 365, Azure cloud services and on-premises systems.
• Continuous Improvement: Support platform upgrades, new feature rollouts and citizen developers while promoting governance best practices. 
The Profile We Are Looking For:

• At least 8 years of relevant professional experience in Microsoft technologies, including enterprise governance and administration.
• Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, Dataverse and Power Automate.
• Proven experience implementing governance frameworks across Microsoft 365 environments.
• Experience defining and enforcing DLP policies, environment strategies and access controls.
• Solid understanding of enterprise administration, including tenant management, environment configuration and capacity management.
• Experience supporting and troubleshooting business-critical applications and automated workflows.
• Knowledge of Microsoft 365 integrations, including SharePoint, Dynamics 365 and Power BI.
• Experience integrating Microsoft cloud services with on-premises infrastructure or Azure environments.
• Ability to work independently, troubleshoot complex technical issues and collaborate with international teams.
• Excellent communication skills in English.
Key Skills:

• Microsoft Power Platform: Administration, governance, environment management and security.
• Microsoft Dataverse: Database administration, permissions, security roles, backups and capacity management.
• Power Automate: Workflow monitoring, troubleshooting, connectors and optimisation.
• Copilot Studio: Agent administration, lifecycle management and security.
• Microsoft 365: Enterprise governance, administration and integration.
• DLP & Security: Data Loss Prevention policies, access control, auditing and compliance.
• Azure Integration: Cloud services, APIs, data gateways and hybrid connectivity.
• Application Lifecycle Management (ALM): Deployment processes, environment strategies and platform maintenance.
Desired Qualifications:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field.
• Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including conditional access, app registrations, role-based access and group-based licensing.
• Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including identity management, networking, storage and application integrations.
• Knowledge of Microsoft Purview or other Microsoft compliance and security tools.
• Experience with enterprise-level governance frameworks and security best practices. 
Additional Information:

• Location: Brussels, Belgium
• Working arrangement: Hybrid - 2 days per week on-site in Brussels.
Joining us means contributing to high-impact international IT projects within a complex and multicultural environment.

You will have the opportunity to work with enterprise-level Microsoft Power Platform, Dataverse, Power Automate and Copilot Studio technologies, strengthen your expertise in platform administration, cloud integration, security, governance and automation, and contribute to the reliability and continuous improvement of critical IT systems supporting European institutions.

At 
World of Tents in Ronse, we design, develop and supply shelter solutions and crisis response equipment for organisations operating in some of the world's most demanding environments.
 

Our brands 
ALPINTER and SHIELD, support humanitarian organisations, governments, defence and emergency response teams with reliable products designed to perform when it matters most. To strengthen our Quality team, we are looking for a QHSE Specialist who combines an eye for detail with a hands-on mindset and a passion for continuous improvement in product and performance.
 

WHAT WILL YOU DO? 
As our Quality Management Officer, you contribute to the appropriate quality and reliability of our products, from raw materials to finished solutions. Working closely with our QHSE Manager, WOT Teams, international suppliers and external specialist stakeholders, you combine 
quality management processes, QA/QC coordination with our manufacturing partners and product testing, in a practical & problem-solving manner.
 

Here's where you will make a difference:
